basic_details.job_title: AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026 – Apply Offline for Librarian, Laundry Manager and More Posts
basic_details.short_information: All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Patna (AIIMS Patna) has notified 3 vacancies on a deputation basis for Librarian Grade-I (Documentalist), Manager / Supervisor / Gas Officer, and Laundry Manager posts. Eligible candidates must submit their offline applications through Speed Post or Registered Post to the Recruitment Cell, All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Phulwarisharif, Patna on or before 24 November 2026. Qualifications and pay scales vary by post, with Librarian Grade-I (Documentalist) and Manager / Supervisor / Gas Officer carrying Level-7 (Rs. 44,900-1,42,400), and Laundry

important_dates.last_date_to_apply: 24 November 2026 (45 days from publication in Employment News)

qualification.details: Librarian Grade-I (Documentalist) Eligibility: Officers under Central/State Governments/U.T./Autonomous Bodies holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 3 years regular service in grade pay of Rs. 4200/-. Essential qualifications include a Bachelor's degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science from a recognized University/Institute (or B.Sc. Degree / equivalent plus Bachelor Degree or Graduate Diploma / Equivalent in Library Science), 5 years' experience in a library of repute, and ability to use computers with hands-on experience in office applications, spreadsheets, and presentations. Desirable: Diploma in Computer Applications. | Manager / Supervisor / Gas Officer Eligibility: Official holding analogous post in Government Organizations or holding posts with 11 years of relevant experience in grade pay of Rs. 2800/-. Essential qualification includes a Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 5 or 7 years working experience with Manifold or its repairs in a supervisory capacity in a Medical Setup, and must be capable of carrying out work associated with Medical Gas Management distribution line, taps, cocks, and outlets. | Laundry Manager Eligibility: Officers working in a minimum 200-bedded hospital of Central/State/U.T. Governments or Central/Autonomous/Statutory/Local Self Government Bodies or Public Sector Undertakings holding analogous posts, or holding a post in grade pay of Rs. 2400/- with 10 years of regular service. Essential qualifications include 12th pass, Diploma/Certificate in Dry Cleaning / Laundry Technology from a recognized Institute, and 12 years' experience in a reputed mechanized Laundry. | Age Limit: Maximum age limit for applying for the aforesaid posts on deputation is 56 years as on the last date of posting of application.

selection_process: The selection process is regulated as per the relevant Recruitment Rules/DoPT instructions as applicable. The period of deputation will be for a period of three (3) years and extendable for a maximum period of five years as per DoPT guidelines. Applications without Vigilance Clearance and attested copies of CR/APAR Dossiers will not be considered.

content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Completed applications in the prescribed proforma along with required documents must be sent through proper channel to the following address: Recruitment Cell,All India Institute of Medical Sciences, Phulwarisharif,Patna- 801507 Candidates must send their applications through Speed Post or Registered Post only . The envelope containing the application should be superscribed with "Application for the Post of ____________ on Deputation Basis" .

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Librarian Grade-I (Documentalist) Eligibility: Officers under Central/State Governments/U.T./Autonomous Bodies holding analogous posts on regular basis, or with 3 years regular service in grade pay of Rs. 4200/-. Essential qualifications include a Bachelor's degree in Library Science or Library and Information Science from a recognized University/Institute (or B.Sc. Degree / equivalent plus Bachelor Degree or Graduate Diploma / Equivalent in Library Science), 5 years' experience in a library of repute, and ability to use computers with hands-on experience in office applications, spreadsheets, and presentations. Desirable: Diploma in Computer Applications. Manager / Supervisor / Gas Officer Eligibility: Official holding analogous post in Government Organizations or holding posts with 11 years of relevant experience in grade pay of Rs. 2800/-. Essential qualification includes a Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering with 5 or 7 years working experience with Manifold or its repairs in a supervisory capacity in a Medical Setup, and must be capable of carrying out work associated with Medical Gas Management distribution line, taps, cocks, and outlets. Laundry Manager Eligibility: Officers working in a minimum 200-bedded hospital of Central/State/U.T. Governments or Central/Autonomous/Statutory/Local Self Government Bodies or Public Sector Undertakings holding analogous posts, or holding a post in grade pay of Rs. 2400/- with 10 years of regular service. Essential qualifications include 12th pass, Diploma/Certificate in Dry Cleaning / Laundry Technology from a recognized Institute, and 12 years' experience in a reputed mechanized Laundry. Age Limit: Maximum age limit for applying for the aforesaid posts on deputation is 56 years as on the last date of posting of application.

content_sections.heading: Enclosures
content_sections.text: Duly filled application form in prescribed proforma (Annexure-I) Vigilance clearance strictly in the format given at Annexure-II Comparative chart regarding Pay Scale if not following Central Government Pay Scales, certified by Finance/Accounts Department Up-to-date Confidential Reports / APARs for the last 5 years duly attested by an officer of the rank of Under Secretary of the Government of India or above Documents supporting educational qualifications and experience Latest salary slip

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection process is regulated as per the relevant Recruitment Rules/DoPT instructions as applicable. The period of deputation will be for a period of three (3) years and extendable for a maximum period of five years as per DoPT guidelines. Applications without Vigilance Clearance and attested copies of CR/APAR Dossiers will not be considered.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for AIIMS Patna Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for receipt of completed applications through proper channel is 24 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the maximum age limit for these deputation posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying for the posts on deputation is 56 years as on the last date of posting of application.

faq.question: Q3. What is the duration of the deputation period?
faq.answer: The period of deputation will be for three (3) years and is extendable for a maximum period of five years as per DoPT guidelines.

faq.question: Q4. What documents must be enclosed with the application?
faq.answer: Candidates must enclose attested copies of APARs for the last 5 years, vigilance clearance in Annexure-II, educational and experience certificates, and latest salary slip.
